description: Figure 15 is a grouped bar chart titled "Token Ratio (TR)" that compares the performance of three different language models—RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six distinct evaluation categories displayed along the horizontal axis: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis represents the Token Ratio (TR), scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks indicating increments of 0.10. Each category contains three vertically stacked bars, each colored distinctly: dark blue for RedWhale (our), light blue for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and light gray for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). The chart visually presents the TR values for each model within each category, with numerical labels placed directly above each bar. For instance, in the PT-EVAL category, RedWhale achieves a TR of 0.42, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 achieves 0.46, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) achieves 1.00. In the AVG category, RedWhale achieves a TR of 0.57, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 achieves 0.61, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) achieves 1.00. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the categories listed on the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining beyond their inherent color differentiation.
